You will need: Multiple choice answer sheet Soft clean eraser Soft pencil (type B or HB is recommended) INSTRUCTIONS  There are forty questions on this paper. Answer all questions.  For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the multiple choice answer sheet.  Follow the instructions on the multiple choice answer sheet.  Write in soft pencil.  Write your name, centre number and candidate number on the multiple choice answer sheet in the spaces provided unless this has been done for you.  Do not use correction fluid.  Do not write on any bar codes.  You may use a calculator. INFORMATION  The total mark for this paper is 40.  Each correct answer will score one mark.  Any rough working should be done on this question paper.  The Periodic Table is printed in the question paper.  Important values, constants and standards are printed in the question paper.
Which atom has the same number of electrons as the hydroxide ion, OH–?

options.A: F B Ne C Na D Mg

questions.questionText: In separate experiments, 5.0g samples of each of four s-block metals are added to an excess of water. The gas evolved is collected and its volume measured under the same conditions of temperature and pressure for each sample. Which metal produces the largest volume of gas?

A student reacts 1mol of copper with concentrated nitric acid to produce 1mol of copper(II) nitrate, 2mol of water and substance X. No other product is formed. Substance X does not contain copper or hydrogen. What could be substance X?

options.A: N B N O C NO D NO

Which statement about aluminium chloride is correct?

options.A: Aluminium chloride has a much higher melting point than magnesium chloride due to the small size of the aluminium ion.
options.B: Anhydrous aluminium chloride reacts vigorously with water to form a solution with a pH greater than 7.
options.C: Each Al Cl molecule found in aluminium chloride vapour contains two coordinate bonds.

Which statement for the element in Period 3 and Group 13 of the Periodic Table is correct?

options.A: It has the highest melting point of the elements in its period.
options.B: It has exactly one electron in its shell with principal quantum number 3.
options.C: It forms an oxide that reacts with aqueous sodium hydroxide.
options.D: It forms a chloride that dissolves in water to give a neutral solution.

A mixture contains magnesium carbonate and barium carbonate only. A sample of the mixture is dissolved in nitric acid to produce a solution. How could this solution be processed into a magnesium compound and a separate barium compound?

options.A: Add HCl(aq), filter off the solid barium chloride.
options.B: Add HCl(aq), filter off the solid magnesium chloride.
options.C: Add H SO (aq), filter off the solid barium sulfate.
